difficulty_rationale: A challenging guided proof: even with the auxiliary polynomial given in the hint, it needs the integrality of all derivatives at 0 and at pi (via the symmetry f(pi - x) = f(x)), the antiderivative of f sin x obtained from F'' + F = f, and a factorial growth bound; sustained strategic reasoning, comparable to the cotangent proof of the Basel sum already in the bank (difficulty 7).
